arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made on a card whose type is prepaid debit, so all transactions on 'Debit (Prepaid)' cards are caught.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit card' is read as card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'. Plain 'Debit' cards are not included.
